worksheet.deviation_description: High liquid level in Knock-out Drum V-002
causes: Level control valve LCV-301 fails closed
Manual bypass or block valve downstream of LCV-301 accidentally closed
Excessive liquid condensation rate in upstream process
consequences: Liquid carryover into the suction of Syngas Compressor Stage 1 K-002
Severe mechanical damage to K-002 impellers/pistons due to liquid slugging

existing_safeguards.description: Level transmitter, controller, and control valve loop

safeguard_gaps: No independent high-high level alarm or trip to shut down the compressor before liquid carryover occurs
recommendations: Install an independent high-high level alarm (LAHH) and an interlock (LSHH) on V-002 to trip K-002 compressor or close a suction shutdown valve

worksheet.deviation_description: Low liquid level in Knock-out Drum V-002
causes: Level control valve LCV-301 fails open
Under-production of liquid condensate
Excessive draw from a downstream condensate recovery line routed to the Steam Boiler feedwater system
consequences: Gas blowby through the liquid outlet line to the waste water treatment plant
Potential overpressurization and hazardous gas release at the downstream waste water treatment facilities

existing_safeguards.description: Level transmitter, controller, and control valve loop

safeguard_gaps: No independent low-level isolation or low-level alarm
recommendations: Install a low-level alarm (LAL) and low-level trip (LSLL) to automatically close LCV-301 and prevent gas blowby

worksheet.deviation_description: High pressure on K-002 discharge line
causes: Blockage in downstream piping or closed manual valves
Fouling or blockage inside the interstage cooler E-011
Surge or over-speed of the steam turbine driver
consequences: Overpressurization of the discharge piping and E-011 shell/tubes
Potential mechanical failure or line rupture leading to release of toxic and flammable syngas

existing_safeguards.description: Pressure safety valve already installed on the K-002 discharge segment

safeguard_gaps: No discharge safety relief valve (PSV) or high-pressure trip shown on this discharge segment
recommendations: Install a pressure safety valve (PSV) on the K-002 discharge line upstream of any isolation valves, sized for full compressor blocked outlet case
Install a high-pressure trip (PSHH) to shut down steam turbine control valve PCV-301

worksheet.stream_ref: E-011 Process Outlet Line to V-003
worksheet.deviation_description: High process temperature at E-011 outlet
causes: Cooling water control valve TCV-303 fails closed
Loss of cooling water utility flow or high cooling water supply temperature
consequences: High-temperature syngas fed into V-003 and Stage 2 Compressor K-003 suction
Increased suction temperature to K-003 leads to overheating of compressor components and loss of gas density/efficiency

existing_safeguards.description: Temperature controller and valve on cooling water line

safeguard_gaps: No high-temperature alarm or trip to protect the downstream compressor K-003
recommendations: Install a high-temperature alarm (TAH) on the E-011 process outlet line to alert operations before compressor limits are breached

worksheet.deviation_description: Thermal runaway / High temperature in Ammonia Converter R-006
causes: Loss of cooling gas/quench control due to TCV-306, TCV-307, or TCV-308 failing closed
Excessive reactant concentration or feed temperature from feed preheaters
consequences: Exceeding vessel design temperature leading to structural failure/rupture of the high-pressure reactor, causing catastrophic release of toxic ammonia and flammable hydrogen
Simultaneous pressure collapse inside the reactor due to sudden gas contraction from the temperature spike

existing_safeguards.description: Temperature indicators and control loop valves for beds
Pressure safety valve installed on the reactor head

safeguard_gaps: Lack of emergency automatic quench shutdown system (SIS) to mitigate runaway reactions
recommendations: Install a safety-instrumented system (SIS) with emergency depressurization (blowdown) and feed isolation valves triggered by reactor high-high bed temperatures

worksheet.deviation_description: Reduced feed flow rate to Ammonia Converter R-006
causes: Upstream compressor K-004 trip or speed reduction
Control valve failure upstream or block valve inadvertently closed
consequences: Potential upset in downstream heat recovery exchangers (E-014, E-015, E-016) leading to thermal shock and piping stresses
safeguard_gaps: No low-flow warning or automatic compressor/heater interlocks on reactor feed line
recommendations: Install a flow transmitter (FT) on the reactor inlet line with low-flow alarm (FAL) to initiate orderly system turnaround or standby mode

worksheet.deviation_description: High liquid ammonia level in Ammonia Separator V-006
causes: Level control valve LCV-305 fails closed
Discharge line block valve closed or downstream piping to T-001 blocked
Sudden increase in liquid condensation/production rate
consequences: Liquid ammonia carryover into the recycle compressor K-005 suction line
Severe liquid slugging and mechanical damage to K-005, risking compressor seal blow and ammonia release
safeguard_gaps: No independent high-high level trip to safeguard K-005
recommendations: Install an independent high-high level alarm (LAHH) and emergency shutdown switch (LSHH) on V-006 configured to trip the recycle compressor K-005

worksheet.deviation_description: Reverse gas flow through Recycle Compressor K-005
causes: Trip of compressor K-005 while downstream systems are fully pressurized and isolation valves remain open
consequences: High-pressure downstream gas flows backwards through K-005, causing backwards rotation
Catastrophic mechanical/bearing failure of K-005 and potential external release of pressurized, toxic syngas/ammonia mixture
safeguard_gaps: No check valve shown on the immediate discharge line of K-005 in this segment
recommendations: Install a high-reliability non-return (check) valve on the discharge of compressor K-005 to prevent backflow upon trip

worksheet.deviation_description: No liquid ammonia transfer flow to storage tank T-004
causes: Transfer pump trip or mechanical seal failure
Block valve closed inadvertently after maintenance
consequences: Backup of liquid ammonia into upstream separator V-006, risking high-level trip cascading upstream
safeguard_gaps: No flow monitoring or low-flow alarm on the transfer line to storage
recommendations: Install a flow transmitter with low-flow alarm on the ammonia transfer line to storage tank T-004
